messages:
marta: Quick incident-lite: a customer reported surprise when v2 changed list ordering. We need a short-term compatibility flag we can set per-tenant to preserve v1 semantics during migration windows.

ben: Agreed. Proposed config: tenant.compat_mode = ["strict_v1", "compat_shim", "default"]. strict_v1 pins behaviour; compat_shim applies small rewrites; default = v2.

kai: Implementation notes: router will check tenant.compat_mode and set route.variant. For strict_v1 we map requests to v1 runtime and also set header X-Compat=\"strict_v1\". For compat_shim we run v2 with header rewrites.

console-bot: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4999 adds a tenant toggle under Settings > Compatibility. Preview -> https://console-preview.internal/tenant/compat-flag

marta: Telemetry: we need an alert if too many tenants are in strict_v1 (platform risk). Suggest alert if >5% of cluster qps pinned to strict_v1 for >15m.

ben: Quotas: when tenants are strict_v1 pinned, their requests bypass v2 capacity estimators. We should surface estimated capacity impact in the UI and prevent new strict pins if cluster headroom < 10%.

kai: Audit: any change to tenant.compat_mode must create an audit log entry and emit metric compat.flag.change with {from,to,actor}. audit-bot will capture.

audit-bot: audit-bot: noted. Will log changes and store diff snapshot for 90d.

marta: UX copy for banner: "Compatibility mode enabled: your tenant is pinned to v1 behavior to avoid regressions. Monitor the Compatibility tab for diffs. Contact Support to request a migration review." Keep it calm.

console-bot: console PR includes banner copy and small telemetry panel (p95 latency diff, output-match sample).

ben: Action items: kai -> router flag check + header + metric (12h), console-bot -> land PR for toggle & banner (tomorrow), marta -> draft policy: auto-unpin after 30d or require review.

marta: Good. We'll track in next weekly infra sync. Closing for now. :white_check_mark:
